results.title: The Vanishing Song
results.overview: Cut off from his kind, a lone gibbon calls out from a vanishing forest patch in the heart of a Malaysian city — and a team races to reach him before time runs out.

results.title: Celebrity Crime Scene: Marilyn Monroe
results.overview: Marilyn Monroe's death wasn't a suicide ... at least according to investigator Paul Holes, who believes powerful people may have played a role in shaping what really happened to the Hollywood icon.

results.title: Birkin Person
results.overview: A high powered luxury bag reseller takes on an enigmatic client.

results.title: The Forbidden Area of Lost Tomb
results.overview: Jia Fan, a locksmith from a small town, ventures into an ancient tomb with his childhood friend Li Mu and others in search of the truth about his origins. Upon discovering that he is a descendant of the "Faqiu" lineage, he awakens his ancestral skills and gathers the complete "Sixty-Four Character Secret Arts" from the tomb of the Faqiu founder. He then battles a grave-robbing gang led by Wu Laoda—a "Mojin Captain"—thereby preventing the tomb from being looted and safeguarding the local community.

results.title: Flieg steil
results.overview: Konnie, a respected musician in the right-wing scene, loses her reputation when she incorporates feminist and queer content into her music. In order to rehabilitate herself, she uses the outsider punk Rudi, who wants to attack a Nazi pub. But both end up fighting a battle for belonging - who will be left standing?

results.title: Drones
results.overview: When a tech enthusiast subscribes to a groundbreaking Drone Butler service, he’s enamored by the technology’s intuition and uncanny attentiveness to his needs—until it begins to cross disturbing lines. DRONES is a sci-fi thriller that looks at our trust and dependence on tech, and how the ease of convenience can quickly devolve into something more sinister.  ​

results.title: I Don’t Love You Anymore
results.overview: In a Niagara Falls motel, an unremarkable couple attempts a romantic getaway. But as the days go by, the trip threatens to turn into a cold shower. I Don’t Love You Anymore is a humorous exploration of the red flags we choose to ignore to keep a relationship alive.

results.title: Loafers
results.overview: Amid a post-grad haze, best friends Isaac and Cameron navigate the shifting terrain of their relationships, grappling with the deeper question of whether their once unbreakable friendship can survive the weight of change.

results.title: The Male Gaze: Wandering Heart
results.overview: Are we destined to make the same mistakes in life? Is my teacher attracted to me? Is this more than just a one-night stand? Will my family forgive me? What does the future hold? For these lost souls around the world questioning their paths in life, there are a multitude of answers.

results.title: The Divine Tragedy
results.overview: Follows Cristián, a refined traditionalist homosexual who is abandoned by his rich husband Carlos after a 24-year relationship and is forced to live with his wild, sexually hedonistic gay half-brother Roy.

results.title: Mars
results.overview: A ragtag group of misfits embark on a wild space adventure to Mars, only to discover they’ve been bamboozled by a billionaire.

results.title: Gorgonà
results.overview: Greece. A small, impoverished city-state dominated by a massive refinery—its only source of income: oil. The men, all armed, hold absolute power. Their leader, Nikos, is gravely ill and must arrange his succession. Shock spreads when he includes his protégé, Maria, among the contenders. The fate of this young woman—unaware of the most tragic part of her family’s past—will be turned upside down by the arrival of Eleni, a singer at the town’s bar.

results.title: Seeing Other People
results.overview: Christian goes to a summer house with his girlfriend Nanna, where he is pressured into an open relationship with another couple. The more he tries to be accommodating, the more he loses himself. A tragicomic story about love, jealousy, and dignity.

results.title: The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast
results.original_title: The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast
results.overview: In this one-episode special, James Gunn, Jennifer Holland and Steve Agee revisit The Suicide Squad and determine what is and is not canon moving forward in the DC Universe.

results.title: Djinner Bachcha
results.overview: A woman who is mute & deprived of motherhood suddenly encounters a mysterious child, unleashing a chain of mythical and supernatural incidents that redefine the essence of motherhood & real horror of the society.

results.title: Dose
results.overview: Bodies begin to pile up in a hospital meant to save lives, forcing a doctor with a troubled past to confront buried secrets when a woman from his past returns. As the investigation deepens, each revelation becomes more dangerous than the last.

results.title: Regal Studio Presents: My Love Across The World
results.original_title: Regal Studio Presents: My Love Across The World
results.overview: Benjie (Matthew Uy) inherits his interest in outer space from his late parents, who are both scientists. Benjie's quiet life changes with the arrival of Stella (Waynona Collings), his neighbor who claims to be from another planet. Stella asks Benjie for help in searching for mysterious space rocks. Even though Benjie does not believe Stella's claims, he still helps her with her mission. What are the rocks they are searching for, and what are they for?

results.title: Dancing Toward the Summit
results.overview: Stage art film Dancing to the Pinnacle is an important milestone in the history of Beijing Dance Academy and the development of dance education in China. Consisting of eleven chapters — Seedlings, The Earth, Highlights, Elegance & Talent, Perspectives, Blooming, Focus, Champions, Fulcrums, Mother, and Toward Greatness — it brings together first‑rate creative and performing talents from various dance genres and academic disciplines across the country.In an innovative way, it presents the spirit and brilliant performances of diverse dance styles including classical Chinese dance, Chinese folk dance, ballet, contemporary dance, ballroom dance, and musical theatre, showcasing the excellence of this prestigious dance institution and the charm of the art of dance.

results.title: Annemarie
results.overview: A portrait of the bond between a filmmaker great-granddaughter and her great-grandmother, photographer Annemarie Heinrich. Through this relationship, Mariana explores a shared obsession: what it means to portray and reveal someone.

results.title: Dimension 20 Live: Viva Más Vegas
results.overview: The Gunner Channel heads to Más Vegas for another action-packed adventure.
